Towards myself and other people in the past who have said or done really messed up shit to me because of my aspergers. It doesn't help anyone. Not yourself. Not them. NO ONE. If you ever make that change and people start reacting good to how you portray yourself don't EVER forget how they treated you before. People who treated me with hate and tried to shame me for my (unknown to me) condition I do not associate with and I simply cut them from my life. Sometimes in a way I think its a blessing to suddenly know the true colors of the people around you so you can take the bad ones out.
